subject: Live output freeze during long transcript — urgent escalation
messages:
From: Tom Schmidt <tom.schmidt@verticallabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Live output freeze during demo (tokens stop mid-stream)

Ben —

We hit a pretty bad issue during a demo this morning. Our app streams transcript tokens to the UI and midway through a 12k-token response the client went silent for ~38s, then received a huge chunk with repeated tokens (out-of-order fragments). The user retried and saw a 502 from your edge. This happened in two separate sessions (IDs attached). Impact: demo failed, engineering team blocked from validating a POC.

Attached: session-logs-20270208.txt, request-ids-20270208.csv, pcap-trace-20270208.pcap

Key details:
- Region: us-west-2
- Model: redwood-large-2026-v2 (hosted)
- Mode: websocket streaming (client-side chunking)
- First occurrence: 2027-02-08T21:45:18Z (see logs)

We need immediate triage and an interim mitigation — happy to fall back to non-streaming if that helps. This is high priority for Vertical Labs. Please advise next steps and ETA.

Thanks,
Tom
Principal Engineer
Vertical Labs

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Tom — thanks for sending the logs and the pcap. I'm really sorry you hit this during a demo. I'm looping in Marissa (CS) and Hannah (Engineering) to triage immediately.

Interim options while we investigate:
- Switch your client to non-streaming mode (single-response) — Marissa can coordinate a config flip on your account.
- Route traffic to a dedicated serving pool (we can spin up a small dedicated variant for your account for the demo).

Marissa — can you provision a dedicated variant + set keepalive to 15s temporarily? Hannah — any early thoughts from a quick look at the pcap?

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Tom — sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as P1 and will do two things right away:
1) Provision a dedicated serving variant for Vertical Labs in us-west-2 and route your demo traffic there (should be ready in ~20–30m).
2) Ask Engineering for a quick diagnostic pass on the chunked-transfer behavior; we'll also apply a temporary keepalive extension on the front proxy to reduce premature timeouts.

Could you also attach the exact websocket request IDs (we received several in the CSV but want to make sure we use the matching request id pairs)? If you can share the browser console trace that would help too.

If you prefer a phone call now, I'm available at +1-415-555-0123.

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: tom.schmidt@verticallabs.com
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live output freeze during demo (tokens stop mid-stream)

Quick triage notes (initial, from the pcap and logs):
- Pattern suggests chunked transfer boundary misalignment when response payloads exceed ~64KB; middle-of-stream idle then bulk flush.
- Edge proxy (nginx-ish LB) is closing idle connections at 30s; the runtime's chunk flush happens after the internal KV-cache boundary and appears to deliver multiple buffered panels at once.
- Error rates: saw elevated 502/504s for the affected request IDs; overall system error rate unchanged but user-visible failure for streaming paths.

Immediate asks from us to Vertical Labs:
- Provide the exact websocket request ids marked in your CSV and point to the timestamped browser console logs.
- If possible, temporarily toggle to non-streaming for the demo (we'll keep the dedicated pool warm).

I'll push a hotfix candidate to adjust chunk flush timing and increase the proxy keepalive window, but that requires a short maintenance window and coordination with infra. I'll share a small log bundle request link for automated collection.

—Hannah
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
